## Is your feature request related to a problem?

Describe the workflow or limitation that prompted this request. What can't you do today?

## Describe the solution

What should the new tool or changed behavior do? Be specific — include the tool name, what inputs it would take, and what it would return if applicable.

## Which Microsoft 365 domain does this touch?

- [ ] Mail
- [ ] Calendar
- [ ] Tasks (Microsoft To Do)
- [ ] Contacts
- [ ] Other (describe):

## Additional context

Links to relevant Microsoft Graph API documentation, related issues, or examples are helpful.
